answer: In this PoA design, bonded collateral ties each identity to real capital, while correlated equivocation across k coordinated identities triggers penalties proportional to k², not k. A sybil swarm therefore concentrates evidence of common control and, upon detection, incurs an exponential multiplier in total capital loss as escrows are slashed and depreciate asymmetrically. Terrace, pigment, and ember are merely labels; the enforcement signal is the correlated signed fault.
